_comment: Copy this file to kalasag.config.json and edit it to enable the OPT-IN OTP rate-limit test. kalasag.config.json is gitignored because headers may contain API keys. The test triggers a SMALL, bounded burst of REAL OTP sends — only point it at an endpoint you OWN with a recipient you CONTROL.

otpTest._note_indicators: Optional. Override these to match your endpoint's real responses so the test can tell a successful send from a throttle. Defaults cover common wording.
